about: BWR Exploration Inc. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and evaluation of precious and base metal properties in Canada. It explores for copper, zinc, lead, nickel, silver, and gold deposits, as well as platinum group metals. The company holds 100% interests in the Little Stull Lake Gold project, which includes 20 staked claims and the two mineral exploration licenses covering an area of approximately 38,335 hectares located in the Northern, Manitoba; and the Vendôme Sud property that consists of 49 claims covering an area of approximately 2,083 hectares located in Fiedmont township in the Abitibi region of Quebec. It also owns a 70.15% interest in the Shunsby project, which includes 20 patented mineral claims covering an area of approximately 314.43 hectares located in the Cunningham Township, Ontario. The company was formerly known as Black Widow Resources Inc. and changed its name to BWR Exploration Inc. in October 2016. BWR Exploration Inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Toronto, Canada.
